build_vision_module: build a ResNet50 vision module with pretrained weights and frozen parameters using get_vision_module
create_vision_modules_pair: create shared or separate encoder and receiver vision modules using get_vision_modules for SSL training
build_vision_module_wrapper: build a VisionModule that encodes sender and receiver inputs using shared or separate encoders
create_simclr_sender: create a SimCLRSender neural network that projects ResNet output with optional discrete evaluation mode
build_emcom_ssl_game: build an EmComSSLSymbolGame that runs sender-receiver communication with Gumbel-Softmax or SimCLR message passing
